Reconstructable raw runs are seeds 21001 and 21011. They are energy-confounded pilot histories, not a confirmatory sample.

records.scope: The locked 1.25x endpoint for three consecutive boundaries was not reached by the positive control. Zeros on the arms do not falsify an intervention. Round-4 FALSIFIED_IN_MODEL is retained history, not the standing verdict.

The measured bracket c* in (1.1, 1.2] belongs only to infection_cost=0.4, generations=400, host_cap=400, parasite_cap=16, turnovers {1, 6, 12}, seeds 8000-8099. It is not a result for other regimes or horizons, and it does not support maintenance of sex at the classical two-fold cost.

The 63-65% share is an estimator label on a synthetic fitness map. It is not an organism-level result. Nearest prior framing is an SCM do-operator; the tested difference is a noise-free mutation-draw intervention, and that difference is an instrument check.
